scope: All tracked Wiki application, API, frontend, task, OAuth, provider, deployment and infrastructure sources. Retained explicit machines and concrete framework/provider exceptions are recorded below; source coverage identifies the reviewed content.

machines.oldRepresentation: stage plus optional output/revision/result
machines.authoritativeReplacement: PlannedCopyCheckpoint | CreatingCopyCheckpoint | CreatedCopyCheckpoint | VerifiedCopyCheckpoint
machines.recovery: Creating is persisted before external mutation; recovery uses exact provider identity and readback. Valid v1 payloads decode directly to variants; no content rewrite.

machines.oldRepresentation: stage plus optional output/result
machines.authoritativeReplacement: PlannedWordCheckpoint | CreatingWordCheckpoint | CreatedWordCheckpoint | VerifiedWordCheckpoint
machines.recovery: Never create a second document for an ambiguous upload; match reserved ID, source binding and exact content.

machines.oldRepresentation: stage plus optional marker/digest/requests
machines.authoritativeReplacement: HeaderInPlaceCheckpoint | ContentInPlaceCheckpoint | NoopContentInPlaceCheckpoint | CompletedInPlaceCheckpoint; transition_in_place
machines.recovery: Durable markers distinguish committed effects; mismatches require review. Old no-op content/completed markers normalize to absent because no request could have consumed them.

machines.oldRepresentation: stage, empty revision sentinel and created-ID bag
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Planned/Creating/Created/Moving/VerifiedStructureCheckpoint; stage-specific functions
machines.recovery: Creating/moving is durable before mutation. Ambiguous tab creation is not repeated; exact topology/marker/content readback required.

machines.oldRepresentation: stage plus nullable generated footer ID
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Creating | Populating | Completed | SkippedNativeFooterCheckpoint and advance_footer
guards: skipped complete requires inactive all-skipped coverage
machines.recovery: Readback before resumption; coverage completed entries are terminal typed evidence. active is immutable plan eligibility, not a second execution phase.

machines.oldRepresentation: completion boolean with nullable decline reason
machines.authoritativeReplacement: PendingNativeDateCheckpoint | DeclinedNativeDateCheckpoint | CompletedNativeDateCheckpoint
machines.recovery: Decline persists before continuation; replay can only reattempt rejected CAS with exact unchanged preimage. Complete and declined cannot coexist.

machines.oldRepresentation: complete boolean and optional revision
machines.authoritativeReplacement: PlannedReadabilityCheckpoint | CompletedReadabilityCheckpoint
machines.recovery: Unknown outcome is resolved by verified projection; changed source never authorizes another batch.

machines.oldRepresentation: nullable credential, expiry, generation and lease combinations
machines.authoritativeReplacement: UseGoogleAccess | AcquireGoogleRefresh(RefreshGrant) | AwaitGoogleRefresh | RequireGoogleLogin; decide_google_token
machines.recovery: Expired workers cannot overwrite renewed grants. Rotation/revocation refetches identity and preserves refresh credentials; unusable orphan access tokens cleared by migration.

machines.oldRepresentation: multiple booleans and nullable task/result/error fields
machines.authoritativeReplacement: PolishState/PolishEvent discriminated unions and transitionPolish reducer
machines.recovery: Stale events ignored; uncertain submission retains durable recovery reference and cannot silently submit again.

machines.oldRepresentation: SQL status/lease/deadline/checkpoint/result fields
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Kind-discriminated TaskRead containing six status-discriminated variants; correlated NewTaskReservation(pending, created) | ExistingTaskReservation and running-only TaskClaim. needs_review retains forensic input/checkpoint and cannot be claimed. The frontend separates running tasks with required positive attempt and execution state from pending/cancelled tasks, which carry neither field.
events: require review after uncertain external effect
guards: Strict runtime models for both task kinds and their six states
Current lease token and checkpoint generation CAS
Prospective terminal model validation before commit
Review status and evidence constraints; no lossy downgrade
Authorization before binding fresh replay keys
A running SQL projection requires a lease expiry. Live and expired expiries project to running and retrying; the frontend rejects missing or invalid running evidence.
machines.recovery: 0029 converts expired running leases to needs_review under an exclusive table lock after refusing live leases. Reviews retain original, alias and fresh replay keys and target reservations indefinitely. Pending undispatched tasks may expire safely. Ambiguous external actions are never repeated because an acknowledgement or negative provider search is missing.

resultTyping.previous: SucceededTaskRead accepted either command kind with either result type.
resultTyping.replacement: SmartCreateSucceededTaskRead(kind=file.smart_create, result=SmartCreateResult) | DocumentTransformSucceededTaskRead(kind=file.document_transform, result=DocumentTransformResult), nested under the status discriminator.
resultTyping.invalidTransitions: Runtime validation rejects a result for another command kind or a result whose task/operation ID differs from its enclosing task. The transition validates the returned state before commit; errors and cancellation roll back.
resultTyping.migration: 0028 result invariants were applied and production-verified in merged PR652. Proposed 0029 adds review invariants and retains expired worker evidence; downgrade refuses unresolved review records.
resultTyping.verification: PR652 required CI, complete backend/frontend suites, real PostgreSQL result invariants and protected production deployment passed. Follow-up review/copy recovery checks and migration verification remain pending.

machines.oldRepresentation: task plus Cloud Tasks delivery and transient execution
machines.authoritativeReplacement: durable task lease/checkpoint protocol and owned worker cancellation
machines.recovery: A crash does not prove provider mutation absent. Recovery checks provider markers/IDs/content; uncertain irreversible writes require review.

machines.oldRepresentation: session ID/revoked timestamp/token version
machines.authoritativeReplacement: UserSession identity and canonical session revoke/refresh SQL
machines.recovery: revoked_at is an Option timestamp with two valid alternatives; no contradictory dependent payload. DB is authoritative, not a cached auth boolean.

machines.oldRepresentation: intent/code/access/refresh collections and grants
machines.authoritativeReplacement: native issuer typed request/response models, encrypted collection purpose and PostgresOAuthOperations
machines.recovery: Code/refresh replay fails; revocation binds grants across tokens. OAuth proxy, its adapter, tables and compatibility paths were already retired by migration 0026.

machines.oldRepresentation: active/retired row and requested slug
machines.authoritativeReplacement: canonical alias service transactions and permanent retired name reservations
machines.recovery: Retired slugs remain audit/identity evidence and cannot be reassigned; timestamp Option is sufficient explicit state.

machines.oldRepresentation: task result plus durable proof
machines.authoritativeReplacement: typed HeaderIdentityEvidence/HeaderIdentityFinalization and independent provenance record
machines.recovery: Retained after task expiry to prevent deleting authorization proof; unknown or stale proof denies mutation.

machines.oldRepresentation: provider snapshots, request generations and query cache flags
machines.authoritativeReplacement: principal-scoped cache versions; canonical query/store mutations and cancellation ownership
machines.recovery: Cached data is a materialized view, never authorization. Independent loading/error/data snapshots are React/query framework boundary states; mutation outcomes retain their typed result contracts.

machines.oldRepresentation: eligibility booleans and optional feature plans
machines.authoritativeReplacement: typed plans/findings and provider JSON boundary validation
machines.recovery: Independent observed capabilities are facts, not workflow phases. Optional plan means no selected operation; omitted plans never authorize provider effects.

machines.oldRepresentation: build, migration job, revision and release artifacts
machines.authoritativeReplacement: canonical release gate/immutable image identity and migration command contract
machines.recovery: Deployment failures remain failures; migration job cannot be repurposed as arbitrary diagnostics. Temporary read-only audit job is removed after production verification.

machines.oldRepresentation: mounted/open booleans with one invalid combination
machines.authoritativeReplacement: DeferredDialogState = unmounted | open | closed
machines.recovery: Closing retains mounting for resource reuse; reset follows React component lifetime.

machines.oldRepresentation: Provider appProperties and recovery search without a SQL dispatch checkpoint; missing search result could repeat a successful but unacknowledged copy.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: PlannedPresentationCheckpoint | CreatingPresentationCheckpoint | CreatedPresentationCheckpoint(output) | VerifiedPresentationCheckpoint(output,result), encrypted in the existing checkpoint column.
guards: owned lease and generation CAS before dispatch
machines.recovery: Creating without positive provider recovery requires review; absence from search does not authorize a second copy. A lost SQL acknowledgement retains creation intent. Positive recovery resumes verification and preserves the saved result. Existing legacy expired workers migrate to review rather than being replayed.
machines.verification: Native source analysis and four type checkers passed; focused runtime, real PostgreSQL migration/concurrency and MCP transaction fixtures passed on 2026-11-12. Protected full repository and production release qualification remains an independent gate.

machines.oldRepresentation: Optional resource ID and provider task marker; retry searched then created again after an ambiguous acknowledgement. Active/terminal DTOs shared a mandatory replay payload.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: SmartCreateCheckpoint(creating) persisted once under the owned running lease; SmartCreateDispatch started | already_attempted; active and settled kind-scoped task records, with needs_review on uncertain acceptance.
guards: lease token and expiry before dispatch
runtime validation of persisted dispatch marker
machines.recovery: A persisted dispatch with no positive recovery cannot create again. Unknown provider acknowledgement requires review and preserves payload/checkpoint evidence. Existing alias/icon enrichment operates only after output identity is known.
machines.verification: Native source analysis and four type checkers passed; focused runtime, real PostgreSQL migration/concurrency and MCP transaction fixtures passed on 2026-11-12. Protected full repository and production release qualification remains an independent gate.

machines.oldRepresentation: Seven independent optional mutation fields and a completed boolean on PresentationDraft.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: ReadyPresentation | PendingPresentationMutation(plan) | AppliedPresentationMutation(plan) | RecordedPresentationMutation(digest) | CompletedPresentationMutation(receipt), with exhaustive receipt/plan selectors.
events: persist expected plan and base revision
guards: runtime provider metadata decoder rejects missing/conflicting plan fields and completion without receipt
pending readback verifies all expected fingerprints before acknowledgement
machines.recovery: Provider metadata is parsed into one closed state before use. A pending mutation with unchanged base revision may retry its revision-fenced batch; a matching changed postcondition records acknowledgement; any different revision or contradictory marker requires review. Existing digest-only acknowledgements retain an explicit recorded variant without inventing a plan or asserting no external write occurred.
machines.verification: Native source analysis and four type checkers passed; focused runtime, real PostgreSQL migration/concurrency and MCP transaction fixtures passed on 2026-11-12. Protected full repository and production release qualification remains an independent gate.

machines.oldRepresentation: Active task row plus an expired boolean, scattered deadline/lease checks and removal of old running rows during replacement.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: _TransformSlotPhase: live | review | retained_lease | abandoned | expired_pending; one locked recheck after provider admission decides reuse, busy, safe pending replacement, or durable review.
events: Recheck current database clock under row lock
guards: Exact source/request intent; request hash remains usable when private input is unreadable
Current row lock and database clock after authorization await
Unexpired execution lease and grace period stay busy
Evidence and target reservation retained for abandoned work
machines.recovery: The same intent under a fresh, original or alias key reuses the review task. A different intent cannot replace retained source ownership. No review row is deleted to make room for another execution.
machines.verification: Real PostgreSQL tests cover all three retry keys, expired pending/live/grace/boundary/stale cases, evidence preservation and denial of another claim.

machines.oldRepresentation: Failure unconditionally became failed, or loaded a private checkpoint blob without distinguishing evidence of dispatch.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: _FailureCheckpointPhase: absent | encrypted_copy | uncertain; a bounded SQL projection precedes any necessary validated decryption.
events: Retain unknown external effect for review
guards: Current running lease token under row lock
Unreadable, oversized or unsupported checkpoint is uncertain
Only a validated planned copy checkpoint proves dispatch has not started
Public mutation/poll projections omit private payload and checkpoint bytes
machines.recovery: Creating or later copy checkpoints, Smart Create dispatch markers and unreadable persisted data retain needs_review. A crash does not prove an external action was absent. Read-only negative provider evidence cannot authorize another create.
machines.verification: Native PostgreSQL projection test proves unreadable large checkpoints become review with two bounded queries and preserve the recorded resource.

machines.oldRepresentation: Raw encrypted JSON kind probes and nullable ciphertext fields before payload decoding.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: _StoredCheckpointEnvelope: _EncryptedCopyEnvelope(kind copy | word_copy | presentation_copy, version 1, ciphertext) | _EncryptedInPlaceEnvelope(kind in_place, version 2, encrypted plan).
guards: Strict frozen copy envelope with no unknown fields
In-place transport metadata remains typed JSON until the complete strict checkpoint model validates it after decryption
Only null retired QA metadata is normalized for legacy copy payloads
machines.recovery: Malformed envelopes cannot establish an undispatched state or authorize replay; current owned failure handling retains uncertainty. No stored ciphertext is rewritten.
machines.verification: Complete native source, type, checkpoint and PostgreSQL qualification remains required for the final candidate.

machines.oldRepresentation: Separate nullable document-transform parent path and request template derived from two optional configuration inputs.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: _DisabledDocumentTransformQueue | _ConfiguredDocumentTransformQueue(parent, immutable request_template).
guards: Reject partial queue/URL configuration before client construction
Exact HTTPS internal path and OIDC audience
Exhaustive dispatch by the configured queue variant
machines.recovery: Disabled queues refuse document-transform dispatch. Configured calls deserialize a private protobuf for every operation; concurrent Smart Create and document-transform requests cannot overwrite each other. AlreadyExists is idempotent acknowledgement.
machines.verification: Four new queue cases plus the original queue suite; native qualification pending.

machines.oldRepresentation: Failure subclass plus independently mutable retryable/retry_after fields, copied after grouped failures.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Read-only ModelUnavailableError for transient attempts; NoQueueRetryModelError subclasses for permanent failures; ExhaustedModelError preserves validated provider delay but permits neither operation nor queue retry. ModelOutputError permits bounded repair within the same operation.
states: transient: operation and queue retry permitted
invalid output: bounded operation repair only
permanent or exhausted deadline: no retry
attempt budget consumed: terminal ExhaustedModelError with the last observed provider delay
guards: Failure class determines read-only retry policy
Terminal constructors accept neither retry flag nor provider delay
Retry delay is finite and nonnegative
Existing aggregate deadline and provider attempt cap remain enforced
machines.recovery: An exhausted operation never restarts its provider budget through queue redelivery. Fresh wrappers preserve permanent categories and transient retry delay without mutating policy or creating a cyclic exception cause. Provider/model failures do not prove external writes absent; checkpoint certainty separately governs quarantine.
machines.verification: Original live-model policy/privacy fixtures retained; nine new immutable-policy and delay boundary cases added. Native qualification pending.

machines.oldRepresentation: Native document output had independent optional checkpoint and generation fields. A new inspector assumed every task record exposed checkpoint fields, including quarantined review records. Its fixture still constructed the superseded task-record class.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Frozen NativeDocumentInspection(kind=native) | SavedNativeDocumentInspection(kind=saved-task, required nonnegative checkpoint generation, nullable observed checkpoint). attach_saved_checkpoint exhaustively handles Active/Terminal/Review records and validates the saved response through its constructor.
guards: Current Wiki account and scoped Drive source reader
Exact source revision before returning native document
Exact task owner and matching output file
Review records return task_not_claimable without exposing or executing their held checkpoint
Adding a task-record variant fails the exhaustive record match
machines.recovery: Inspection performs provider reads only. Missing checkpoints are observations; generation is independently required for saved tasks. Held encrypted evidence remains in storage and is never treated as permission to resume.

machines.oldRepresentation: DetectedNativeSpan combined a date/place tag with optional date value and skip reason; unresolved and resolved data could coexist.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: ResolvedNativeDateSpan(required date value) | LocatedNativePlaceSpan | BlockedNativeSpan(required reason), immutable tagged variants. Separate constructors require either a resolved value or refusal reason.
events: admit supported date or report skipped candidate
guards: Ambiguous meridiem, dates, timezone or unsupported place insertion remain refused
Only a resolved date reaches provider request construction
Protected quotations and code transition to BlockedNativeSpan, discarding resolved mutation data.
machines.recovery: Pure parsing results. No external side effects; retained nullable read-only projections expose derived absence without permitting contradictory construction.

machines.oldRepresentation: New upstream feature already uses a discriminated pending/completed checkpoint; not a second generic completed flag.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: PendingNativeChipCheckpoint(complete=False, no provider revision) | CompletedNativeChipCheckpoint(complete=True, required provider revision), strict closed checkpoint boundary inside the existing durable in-place checkpoint.
events: read exact marker and converted content
guards: Source revision and complete source digest
Recomputed plan, request batch, spans and marker range must match
Exact provider marker and reversible full-document readback
Completed checkpoints never dispatch a write
CAS ownership and durable checkpoint precede side effects
Version-one plans never newly write protected quotations/code; already-written verified legacy conversions remain review findings.
machines.recovery: A marker permits verification of the original accepted batch. Without it, only the exact original revision/content permits a revision-guarded write; changed or unverified readback requires review. Skipped-only plans still bind the current provider revision. No negative name search or blind duplicate mutation.

machines.oldRepresentation: Independent model_invoked, passes, accepted_improvements, stop_reason and nullable failure code; local draft mutated these independently.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: LegacyReadabilityRefinement | IneligibleReadabilityRefinement | FinishedReadabilityRefinement | DeadlineReadabilityRefinement | InvalidReadabilityRefinement | UnavailableReadabilityRefinement; the immutable draft and checkpoint share this required outcome.
events: stop on convergence or lack of improvement
guards: Strict discriminated recorded outcome boundary; no contradictory recorded failure code or invocation flag
Accepted improvement count never exceeds attempted passes; completed optimization requires a positive pass count
Legacy unknown improvement counts remain unknown; historical invocation evidence and old counters are preserved independently
Typed read-only projections and a validated named serializer preserve existing encrypted receipt JSON; competing representations are refused
machines.recovery: Only the completed local planning outcome is checkpointed. Existing planned/completed readability checkpoints control provider write and exact readback. A no-change, unavailable or deadline receipt remains durable; no new provider calls occur solely to decode history. The named legacy wire DTO is restricted to decoding and serialization projections; it is never an authoritative mutable planning model.

machines.oldRepresentation: Nullable (delimiter,start) tuple switches code mode; active quotation opener map and accumulated protected ranges.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: OutsideCode | InsideCode(required delimiter, UTF-16 opening); exhaustive advance_code returns CodeTransition(required next state and typed protected ranges). Active quote map is an independent collection of open delimiters with required offsets.
guards: Different backtick runs never close each other
Quote tokens inside code cannot change quote membership
Malformed code tokens and ranges are refused
Ambiguous possessives keep the opener; unfinished quotes and code protect the remainder
Single scan and incremental UTF-16 offsets preserve the upstream bounded-runtime behavior
machines.recovery: Pure bounded document parsing with no external effects or persistence; end-of-input emits explicit unclosed ranges, never assumes incomplete text is safe to mutate.

machines.oldRepresentation: Independent opener and continuation maps could represent an orphan continuation; closing and repeated paragraph openers coordinated their membership.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: One QuoteDelimiter-keyed map of EmptyQuotation(required opening) | ContinuingQuotation(required opening and last nonempty paragraph); opening_quotation is a pure exhaustive decision. Closed is absence from this map.
guards: Only a continuing variant carries a prior paragraph
Empty unmatched openers cannot imply continuation
Ambiguous possessives retain the active frame
Monotonic covered-until offsets remain independent deduplication facts; do not reset their bounded-scan behavior
machines.recovery: Pure bounded parsing; no provider effects or durable progress. Existing exact literal, nested quote, whitespace, empty-paragraph, code masking and unrelated prose oracles remain authoritative.

machines.oldRepresentation: Initial-mode boolean, optional positional prefix, optional manifest pair and obsolete bootstrap arguments.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: InitialBaseline | CompareBaselines; execute exhaustively dispatches one validated command.
guards: reject partial version input and retired flags before reading files
initial baseline cannot exempt changed source
per-file existing-rule counts may only shrink
machines.recovery: Read-only deterministic check; invalid inputs exit2 without changing either baseline. Correct evidence and rerun from the exact comparison base.

machines.oldRepresentation: allow_new_rules boolean plus optional base-config text.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: ExistingRules | AdoptedRules(required base_config observation); exhaustive _adopted_rule.
guards: a real bundle transition is required
already configured rules and existing baseline rules cannot gain findings
unknown partial manifest pair is rejected
machines.recovery: No baseline mutation. A missing prior configuration is an independent legacy observation retained only in AdoptedRules, with the original new-rule policy.

exceptions: Google Docs/Drive/Word JSON uses provider-specific request objects at runtime boundaries. Existing Any annotations are wire adapters; new authoritative checkpoint unions and transition data are closed, validated models.

SQL relational task/session/MCP/alias columns are retained where transactional predicates, uniqueness and audit queries require them. Runtime APIs expose validated state-specific models; no new generic workflow engine or duplicate state column is introduced.

Historical encrypted v1/v2 checkpoints preserve their version and content. Every valid old shape decodes into a state variant. Invalid or contradictory state fails closed and remains evidence rather than being silently deleted.

Independent UI selections, form values, immutable policy/capability flags, caches and timeout resource handles are not all-or-nothing workflow payloads. React, AbortController and provider schedulers own their lifecycle; application ownership/generation fences remain explicit.

sourceCoverage.contract: SHA-256 identities of current tracked application, migration, API, job, configuration and infrastructure sources. ReviewedCommit identifies the comparison base; the hashes describe this candidate. Source enumeration supports, but does not replace, the semantic machine inventory.
